==Description==
This template may be used to cite various in-game quests, stories, and cosmetic items from ''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]''.

==Instructions==
'''In-game quests or stories'''
:<code><nowiki>{{HuntersCite|quest=}}</nowiki></code>

'''In-game costumes'''
:<code><nowiki>{{HuntersCite|character=|costume=}}</nowiki></code>

'''Parameters'''
*{{para|quest}} Name of the quest or story you are citing.
*{{para|character}} Complete name of the character which the cosmetic item pertains to.
*{{para|costume}} Name of the costume or weapon skins you are citing.

==Examples==
*{{HuntersCite|quest=Sentinel Mastery II}}

*{{HuntersCite|character=Sentinel|costume=Carnage E-Web}}

*{{HuntersCite|character=Diago Velaar|costume=Aurodium Marksman}}

*{{HuntersCite|character=Grozz|costume=Champion's Clubs}}
